main_text.p: Hos.II.v.2. Constr. בַּעֲלֵי Domini, Jud.9.2.3. Aff. בְּעָלָיו Dominos suos, Eccles.7.13. Cum Affixis etiam sensu singulari usurpatur, Exod.21.29. & 22.11. & saepius eo capite, Jesa.1.3. & alibi. Chald. בַּעַל Dominus, Praeses: בַּעַל טַעַם Praeses consilii, Esr.4.8.

בַּעֲלַת f. Domina: Et Nomen Urbis, Bahala, Jos.15. v.9. בַּעֲלָתָה Bahalam versus, 1.Par.13.6. Constr. בַּעֲלַת אוֹב Domina Pythonis, Pythonissa, vel praedita Pythone, 1.Sam. 28.verf.7. בַּעֲלַת הַבַּיִת Domina domus, Hera domestica, 1.Reg.17.17.

בָּעַר Arsit, Exarsit, Succensus, Combustus fuit: & interdum transitive, Accendit, Exusit, ut Psal.83.15. Item, Obbrutescere, ex significatione Nomi-nis derivati: unde Futur. יִבְעֲרוּ Obbrutescent, Jerem.10. v.8. & sic Particip. בְּעָרִים Obbrutescentes, Brutissimi, Psalm.94.8. At אַנְשֵׁי בְעָרִים Homines ardentes, odio scilicet, id est, infestissimi, juxta Masoretharum notam, Ezech.21.36. Niph.Praet. נִבְעַר Obbrutescit; Jer.10.14. נִבְעֲרוּ Obbrutuerunt, verf.21. & sic Jesa.19.11. Pih. בִּעֵר Ardere fecit, Accendit, Incendit, Succendit, Combusit, Exusit: & inde latius, Sustulit; Removit; ut stipulae ex agris exustione removentur; & sicut herba ab animantibus depascuntur; unde est Pavit, Depavit, ut Exod.22.5. Jesa.3.14. Eadem significat & in Hiphil. Pyh. Particip. מְבֻעֶרֶת Succensa, Jerem.36.v.22. Hiph. Praet. וְהִבְעַרְתִּי Et comburam, Nah.2.13. Partic. מְבַעִיר Sublaturus vel Removurus sum; 1.Reg.16.3. Futur. יְבַעֵר Depaverit, Exod.22.5.
בְּעִיר m. Brutum, Jumentum, Pecus: Aff. בְּעִירָהּ Pecus suum, Exod.22.5. בְּעִירָם Bruta eorum, Psal.78.48.
בַּעַר m. Brutus, Baro, Bardus, id est, Stupidus, Psal.73.22. & 92.v.7.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms are hard to read at this scan resolution; I copied them as seen, and the Hebrew in the entry for בַּעַל טַעַם and the forms in the בָּעַר entry are the least certain. "Hof" in the first line has a long s and is read as Hos. The running head is Hebrew. The catchword at bottom right is the next lemma.
